about: The one repository the real build history may link to: kew itself, since the demo shows how kew was built (#3144). Committed, so the demo build's provenance schema (provenance-schema.ts) pins every PR link in a real provenance.json and runs.json to it and refuses a link to any other repository, whatever the export holds. A publish needs the real export and the owner's approval; a build made without the export bundles the committed samples, which link to the invented acme/kew. The leak scan skips its owner rule and denylist for the repo key of this file only.
